x.instructions: For world axis x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation. Choose positive for increase, negative for decrease, hold for within_tolerance. These are measured hand residuals, not object observations.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
criteria.hold: This axis is within its declared deadband.
